categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Lacks mempool labels and does not change mempool policy or data structures; gating ATMP during snapshot loading is validation chainstate lifecycle management.
categories.rationale: Does not alter mempool acceptance rules or policy, but rather adds an assumeutxo-specific gate inside validation to prevent mempool entry while loading a snapshot.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the Validation label, alters `src/validation.cpp` and `src/validation.h`, and addresses assumeutxo snapshot activation and chainstate initialization.
categories.rationale: Fixes an assertion failure that crashes the node and forces a full `-reindex` when any transaction arrives during snapshot validation. Because `PopulateAndValidateSnapshot` releases `cs_main` for several minutes, receiving any transaction over P2P hits `Assertion failed: (!prev_chainstate.m_mempool || prev_chainstate.m_mempool->size() == 0)` in `AddChainstate`, breaking assumeutxo under normal network conditions.
